traits.name: Golem Antimagic
traits.text: harmed by cold and water (5d10 (5d10), 2d8 (2d8) from areas and persistent damage); healed by acid (area 2d8 (2d8) HP); slowed by earth.

traits.name: Vulnerable to Stone to Flesh
traits.text: A stone to flesh spell negates the golem's golem antimagic and its resistance to physical damage for 1 round. A flesh to stone spell reverses this effect immediately.

traits.name: Impose Paralysis
traits.text: ⬲ (incapacitation); Trigger The stone golem hits a slowed creature. Effect The creature must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save or become paralyzed for 1 round.

traits.name: Inexorable March
traits.text: ⬻ The stone golem Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 34 Fortitude save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

traits.name: Slowing Pulse
traits.text: ⬻ (arcane, concentrate, transmutation); Each creature in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save or be slowed 1 for 1 minute. The golem can't use Slowing Pulse again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.
